events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
This is a no-show cancellation fee dispute; the rider cancelled, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. The rider cancelled 1 min 40 s (100 s) after acceptance [F2], which is within the 3-minute grace period; the NS-4 condition "match + more than 3 minutes" therefore fails, and the rider owes no cancellation fee in that situation [F2][NS-4]. That condition is also what the code trace settled as failed, and it contradicts the charge of $6.61 [F2][F5].

The driver side adds nothing that could revive the fee. The platform's own records show the driver never came within 200 m of the pickup and was 2597 m away at acceptance-time closest approach [F1], no driver_arrived_at was ever recorded [F3], and the driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4]. The driver's post-trip statement "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" [F8] is a statement, not a system record, and it does not assert that any "I'm Here" tap or 3-minute wait occurred; there is no chat at all [F7]. Traces also show no traffic incident and only a mid-band speed reading on an unrelated road [F9][F10], which cannot justify anything here.

Because the charge of $6.61 was not permitted on these facts, the contested item must be returned in full: $6.61 [F5][NS-4]. Refunds of cancellation fees are issued as a Ryde voucher and Ryde retains final discretion [NS-7]. No account flag is warranted: no rule in this record calls for one, and the driver's profile (1 prior upheld dispute) does not by itself trigger an account action.

Safety screen: I read all message text in the file — there is no in-app chat [F7], the driver's statement is a neutral account of being en route [F8], and the complaint is a fare grievance only; nothing is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so no escalation on safety grounds.

Our records also don't show the required arrival steps: never within 200 m of the pickup, no arrival logged, no "I'm Here" tap. The $6.61 is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. We'll note in your record that the arrival conditions weren't met. Your account stays active.
